name: Shenzhen Kingdom Sci-Tech Co., Ltd
summary: Shenzhen Kingdom Sci-Tech Co., Ltd engages in financial technology business in China. The company offers securities business integrated service platform, margin trading and securities lending solutions, stock option solutions, publicly offered securities settlement solution, science and technology innovation growth solution, securities lending and borrowing integrated service platform, and QFII investment and trading solutions; and wealth management solutions, such as off-site counter, full commission management, investment advisory trading, asset allocation, product management, institutional wealth management, and wealth account solutions. It also provides integrated operations, institutional operation, business monitoring, and Jin Hutong overall solutions, as well as real time risk control solutions for transactions; various services comprising overall solutions for information technology innovation, new brokerage, domestic cryptographic modification, securities firm mergers and acquisitions, devOps integrated management, non-functional testing, IT consulting and planning, and joint research and design solutions; and technical services. In addition, the company offers KOCA, an open cloud-native technology platform; KOCA-LDP, a low-latency technology platform; KOCA-HARE, a high-speed message bus; KOCA-LCP, a low-code technology platform; KOCA-DIDA, a big data technology platform; and KOCA-AMO, a monitoring and maintenance platform. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People’s Republic of China.
